name: Summit AZ - Low-Hanging Fruit Plan 2026-09-26
body:
> Plan · Summit Az · 2026-09-26

# Summary
Plan built from Kim's sheet of 16 low-hanging-fruit keywords (GSC Aug 27 to Sep 23), a live crawl of 184 sitemap pages and Search Atlas volumes. Companion: `Summit-AZ-LHF-Keyword-Research-2026-09-26.md` (Search Atlas project 5057064 plus saved projects; the 2,000-keyword quota ran out mid-way).

# Problems found
1. City hubs linked to none of their own city's service pages, so service pages got links only from sibling cities with one-word anchors. Fix: a "Services in <City>" block on each hub with descriptive anchors.
2. Two Queen Creek pages fought over "water heater installation" (Google moved the searches to the tankless page). Fix: split by intent and cross-link.
3. Near-copy pages: leak detection STV 97% (vs Gilbert), water pressure Scottsdale 92% (vs Mesa), leak detection QC 83%, pipe lining Mesa 83%, tankless QC 78%.
4. Quick errors: wrong-service closing headings, lowercase city headings, identical "Testing & Diagnostics" headings, "Gas Line Installation" on an installation page.
5. Pages not saying what people search (low water pressure Scottsdale, sewer line replacement Mesa, slab leak repair Apache Junction, epoxy questions).
6. FAQ answers not written as 40 to 50 word direct answers.

# Keyword picks (LHF research)
- Leak detection STV: leak detection services (2,900 / KD 3). Leak QC: underground water leak detection (1,600 / 18). Leak AJ: kept main, slab leak repair (2,400 / 24). Water pressure Scottsdale: water pressure repair (170 / 26). Pipe lining Mesa: kept, sewer pipe lining (2,400 / 8). Sewer Mesa: kept, sewer line replacement (4,400 / 29). Tankless QC: kept, tankless water heater maintenance (18,100 / 25). Water heater QC: installation (27,100 / 51), leaking, no hot water.
- Four main keywords break the KD 30 rule because no install or repair term for those services passes it; exceptions approved because the pages already rank.

# Decisions and status (Sep 26)
- DONE: hub links (10 hubs, 110 links), heading fixes (8 wrong CTAs, 18 casing fixes, duplicate icon boxes on 9 pages), gas line item replaced with Water Softener Installation, and all 8 page rewrites applied live.
- Open: emergency wording decision, epoxy confirmation, indexing requests for the 8 pages.
